item.title: Magic’s Fitness Companion: An iPhone update, with existing data preserved
item.description: Version 1.7.1 build 33 was installed as an in-place personal iPhone update and accepted by the owner on 9 November 2026. Familiar records and settings were preserved; navigation, local deterministic Ask MrMagic help and a cold reopen were checked. Full accessibility and live scale/watch checks remain outstanding. No public app distribution is announced.
